about.text: A loaf-shaped cheese made from cow's milk. The cheese is lightly pressed, then washed in brine to create the firm, orange crust and pungent aroma.

sources.text: Abbey cheese from Maredsous; lightly pressed, brine-washed orange rind, 22 days cellar maturing; now industrial (Groupe Bel) as well as at the abbey
